content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

Before signing the agreement, I wanted to raise a few points regarding the relevant clause for clarification.

- The relevant clause suggests that I must perform any extra work requested by the Client without receiving additional payment. The proposed change is that the Contractor shall perform requested additional services upon mutual written agreement specifying the scope and associated fee.
- The relevant clause allows the Client to request an unlimited number of revisions until they are satisfied, which could lead to open-ended work. The proposed change is that the Contractor will provide up to 3 rounds of revisions for each Deliverable, and additional revisions may be subject to a written change order.
- The relevant clause states that requests for work outside the defined scope are automatically included as part of the services, which could result in uncompensated extra work. The proposed change is that requests for support or work outside the defined scope will be subject to a written change order detailing the required scope, associated costs, and timeline, and must be approved by both parties prior to execution.
- The relevant clause indicates an unlimited revision allowance, which could impact the project timeline and scope. The proposed change is that the revision allowance: up to 3 rounds.

Thanks,
